fields.statement: QA with a fresh build of the branch (go build -trimpath to a scratch path), in a scratch root with Rex faked and RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG: rhiza daemon --once --permission-mode manual --max-runs 4 started 'run start --foreground <cs> --workflow plan-review --autonomous --permission-mode manual' for the two proposals with a leaf and no run and for one whose only run was abandoned; started nothing for a proposal with no leaves, one a finished plan-review run gated, one whose plan-review run failed, or one a plan-milestone run on another change set gated. With a live plan-review run on a proposal it was not restarted; --permission-mode auto passed through; an accepted change set went to the ship pick; with one slot used and --max-runs 2 the plan-review start took the free slot and the ship pick waited; with --max-runs 1 and the slot used nothing started; nothing started under rhiza.daemon.paused true or with low disk. A pending start is held only within one daemon process (separate --once processes restart it), as for ship starts. Scoped tests: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Proposals|Inbox' and TestScripts/daemon-plans-proposals pass.

QA with the scratch build: rhiza inbox --json listed each proposal with a leaf and no covering run as one accept item, detail 'waiting for acceptance: no plan run covers it', next 'rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>', under rhiza.autonomy.accept auto; a proposal gated by a plan-review or plan-milestone run kept its single 'waiting for acceptance' item and was not listed twice; one whose plan-review run failed showed only its failed item; after rhiza accept (the item's next) and after a live plan-review run journaled, the item was gone; rhiza ready still says 'not accepted: proposed'. Rough edge: plain-text inbox and inbox open print 'run ,' for these run-less items (minor finding). TestScripts/inbox-uncovered-proposal and inbox-owner-run-accept pass.

QA with the scratch build: rhiza workflow ls lists plan-review as builtin; rhiza workflow describe plan-review starts at plan/milestone-check, includes plan, and lists no interview step or planner prompt (review, critic, check, revise, gate, PR steps); rhiza run start on an unknown change set with --workflow plan-review exits 4 with 'no change set'. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... and TestScripts/plan-review-workflow, workflow-ls and plan-workflow pass (the end-to-end run reaching the gate and accepting under rule autonomous).
